name: paullette-repository
description: The repository holding paullette, an AI coding agent command line interface, compatible with the .claude folder, running on any OpenAI API compatible endpoint

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace paullette-core && npm run build --workspace paullette-web && npm run build --workspace paullette
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace paullette-core && npm run typecheck --workspace paullette-web && npm run typecheck --workspace paullette && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace paullette-core && npm run test:unit --workspace paullette-web && npm run test:unit --workspace paullette
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run verify
scripts.publish:all: npm run build && npm version patch --workspaces --include-workspace-root && npm publish --workspace paullette-core && npm publish --workspace paullette-web && npm publish --workspace paullette
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
